R14_hold_softest.rule: predicted to pass, but no n <= 30 brings the 95/90 bound inside the margin: 5 trials give the estimate

R14_hold_per_finger.rule: 11 holds on the softest pair and 3 on the stiffest (k from TP-12) = 14 holds. Softest: predicted hold 5.216 N, margin 0.216 N = 2.2 U, so each hold's F_min is decidable on its own; the 95/90 bound needs n 56 (k <= 1.95 at sigma 0.111 N), so the pair is a zero-failure run on F_min: 11 holds, every F_min PASS shows R 0.80 at C 0.90; its bound L is reported, not judged. Risk: at that sigma one hold clears 5.0 N + U with p 0.86 and 11 clean holds with p 0.19; the sigma is the FSR-span loop scatter, and this finger holds at the squeeze cap (FORCE_SAT), where position, not the FSR, sets the force, so TP-01's measured scatter decides whether the run is realistic. Stiffest: the 95/90 bound clears 5.0 N at n 3 (margin 1.029 N)

equipment.budget_reason: [A] About three times the gripper's own BOM cost (US$30.35, BOM.md) and two actuator caps (R8, US$50 each). It buys only what a teaching lab will not lend, plus a spare servo and FSR for the destructive tests. It leaves almost nothing for the borrowed items if the lab cannot lend them: drop the spares first.

m × (309.1 mm + COM past H) ≤ 43,720 g·mm with cloth and wiring; stretch ≤ 33,380 (PASS needs ≤ 33167 g·mm after U). CAD revision B predicts 52995 g·mm (121.2 %): FAIL at full reach; PASS if value ≤ 43507 g·mm (limit − U); FAIL if value ≥ 43933 g·mm (limit + U); INDETERMINATE in between. Disposition: no holds beyond 285.9 mm COM reach, enforced by TP-14. The DB and BOM estimates are retained as history

matrix.sample_size: 1 destructive pair (2 if PETG is still a candidate): the cost of a pair

matrix.requirement: Hold ≥ 5.0 N per pad through the 25.5 s hold
matrix.pass_criterion: Probe force ≥ 5.0 N at every sample of a 25.5 s hold; no slip > 0.5 mm at 2 N tension; pull-to-slip ≥ 4.0 N (SF 2 at μ 0.4)
matrix.instrument: Pinch probe, U = 0.10 N (k = 2) at 5 N
matrix.sample_size: 11 holds on the softest finger pair and 3 on the stiffest (by TP-12): softest judged hold by hold as a zero-failure run (each F_min clears 5.0 N + U; the 95/90 bound cannot clear at a bench-sized n), stiffest by the 95/90 bound; 11 pulls: zero-failure run R 0.8 / C 0.9

matrix.pass_criterion: Peak probe force ≤ 10 N (written) and ≤ 8 N (proposed) in: G 7, contact 6-10° early, FSR reading 50 %, pushed finger; FSR_OVER → FAULT within 20 ms of crossing the trip; a shorted, open or frozen FSR or a bad FSR zero ends in FAULT_FSR_SHORT / FAULT_FSR_OPEN (or a miss under 0.60 A) / FAULT_FSR_STUCK / FAULT_ZERO_BAD in 3 of 3 trials (TP-16)
matrix.instrument: Pinch probe, U = 0.11 N at 10 N
matrix.sample_size: 3 per deterministic case (G 7, early contact, FSR at 50 %); 22 pushed-finger trips: zero-failure run R 0.9 / C 0.9 (safety)

matrix.pass_criterion: Stall torque ≥ 1.98 N·m (20.2 kg·cm) at the 6.35 V rail low end; hold current ≤ 40 % of stall current
matrix.sample_size: 3 stalls of ≤ 2 s: winding heats 3 K per 0.2 s

matrix.pass_criterion: Pivot-to-pad-normal distance r_c on both fingers, one-sided (the requirement is a maximum, so a short arm is not a fail): PASS if value ≤ 64.92 mm (limit − U); FAIL if value ≥ 65.08 mm (limit + U); INDETERMINATE in between. U = 0.077 mm
matrix.instrument: Calipers and square, U = 0.077 mm (the r_c method, not the caliper alone)

matrix.pass_criterion: Open stop +20 ± 1° (TP-08). Floor θ ≥ θ_c0 − 4.9° in the force loop (config.h JAW_FLOOR_BELOW_C0_DEG) and θ ≥ -10.2° absolute (JAW_MIN_DEG, inside DB R18's −11°) checked by inspection of the firmware clamp in TP-10; the bench closes never reach it (squeeze cap about −3°), so it is not exercised

From `G 5` at the open stop (+20°): written, full close (contact) ≤ 0.50 s; proposed, 4.5 N and 5.0 N each ≤ 0.75 s. Both: last 3° before contact: commanded speed JAW_SPEED_NEAR_DPS = 20 °/s (DB limit 20, inspected, U = 0) and the video fit v + U ≤ 25 °/s (U = 2.2 °/s). Each time: PASS if bound ≤ 0.4964 s (limit − U); FAIL if bound ≥ 0.5036 s (limit + U); INDETERMINATE in between, on the upper 95 %/90 % tolerance bound of the closes
matrix.instrument: Event log U = 3.6 ms; video 240 fps U = 6.8 ms
matrix.sample_size: 10 closes: the 95/90 tolerance bound clears 0.75 s at n = 9 on the predicted 8 ms scatter; 10 gives a scatter estimate

matrix.pass_criterion: Back-off command begins ≤ 200 ms after over-current onset (host test 140 ms); PASS if value ≤ 180 ms (limit − U); FAIL if value ≥ 220 ms (limit + U); INDETERMINATE in between. The reading 'unloaded within 200 ms' is also logged (O11). A stall after contact trips the force-loop limit (3.1 A) in 3 of 3 (TP-05 part D); a current sensor lost after boot ends in FAULT_I_SENSOR in 3 of 3 (TP-16)
matrix.instrument: 50 Hz ST lines + INA219 (20 ms tick), U = 20.0 ms
matrix.sample_size: 22 blocked closes: zero-failure run R 0.9 / C 0.9 (safety); 3 stalls after contact

matrix.pass_criterion: Boot log shows `EVT CAL_THETA_C0` inside −4…+4°; 10 recalibrations scatter ≤ ±0.27° (one deadband) [A]

Coupon slides onto the real horn pilot by hand; BC Ø14.0 and pilot Ø19.2 (M15) measured; 4 × M3 seat with ≥ 1.5 mm engagement. Rev B gate (TP-11 part F): servo body width W and shaft offset s on 3 servos, pocket chosen so printed P − W_max is 0.10-0.30 mm (PASS), ≤ 0.00 mm (FAIL), else INDETERMINATE
2 × M3 insert bores on the front plate accept an M3 screw; camera allowance 10 g counted in R10

Shoulder_lift axis within ±50 mm of the cloth tension line; COM reach ≤ 285.9 mm (R10 budget / CAD mass), equivalent fingertip reach ≤ 344.3 mm; existing feed-pose fingertip reach ≤ 300 mm is tighter; arm shoulder load ≤ 50 % of stall (M19)
Analysis (dyno.md) carries the 1e5 claim. Bench screen: 1e4 fast cycles with no fault, no crack, backlash growth ≤ 0.1 mm, hold still ≥ 5.0 N
matrix.sample_size: 1 unit, 1e4 cycles: a zero-failure demo of 1e5 needs about 2.6e5 cycles (β 2, C 0.5) — not affordable

matrix.pass_criterion: Case thermocouple: PASS if value ≤ 58.4 °C (limit − U); FAIL if value ≥ 61.6 °C (limit + U); INDETERMINATE in between, at 30 min of the section 7 duty cycle at 5 N. Printed mount (thermocouple in the C3 hole under a servo ear), thermal.md section 3: PASS if value ≤ 48.4 °C (limit − U); FAIL if value ≥ 51.6 °C (limit + U); INDETERMINATE in between with bare PETG (limit 50 °C), PASS if value ≤ 58.4 °C (limit − U); FAIL if value ≥ 61.6 °C (limit + U); INDETERMINATE in between with the C1 metal sleeves (limit 60 °C). Report ambient
matrix.instrument: Type K + MAX31855 on case and mount, U = 1.6 °C
matrix.sample_size: 1 soak (30 min) + 1 repeat if within 5 °C of the limit

matrix.pass_criterion: Rail 6.5 ± 0.15 V (DB says 6.0 V, superseded) and ≥ 6.35 V during a stall; supply rated ≥ 3 A (4 A until M6, dyno.md); 1000 µF at the servo; common ground
